note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after 2e4be94ae3). Read at rfc/full/rfc7950.txt Section 9.1: "If the data type does not have a canonical form, the format of the value MUST match the data type's lexical representation, but the exact format is implementation dependent." The types are identityref (Section 9.10.4) and instance-identifier (Section 9.13.3). Both prior findings are fixed. (1) Section 9.13.2 "All node names in an instance-identifier value MUST be qualified with explicit namespace prefixes": checkInstanceKeyPrefix now refuses an unprefixed or foreign key prefix; TestRFC7950InstanceIdentifierKeyPrefix (negative) asserts both messages and the accepted rf:name form, and overlay mutants dropping the empty-prefix branch and the entryPrefixed branch each turned it red. (2) Cascade confounding: TestRFC7950IdentityrefFormat now asserts the format check's own message, and TestRFC7950InstanceIdentifierLexical asserts 'not an instance-identifier' for rf:sys and the unprefixed-node message for /sys/mgmt; overlay mutants removing the identifierRefLength check and the leading-slash check turned each red. A probe of further malformed values (rf:1aes, rf:, :aes, trailing space, //rf:sys, an unquoted key value, [0], mismatched and embedded quotes, a space between steps) found each refused with ErrTypeType.
